plain_text:
Menopause is a natural process, but there are many
safe methods to relieve symptoms that disrupt your
daily life.
semantic_text: Menopause is a natural process, but there are many safe methods to relieve symptoms that disrupt your daily life.

plain_text:
Medications are also available to treat hot flashes and prevent
bone loss that can occur throughout menopause. These
medications may include menopausal hormone therapy. They
could have health risks for certain people with risk factors
such as high blood pressure or a history of certain cancers.
Talk to your doctor about whether these are right for you.
semantic_text: Medications are also available to treat hot flashes and prevent bone loss that can occur throughout menopause. These medications may include menopausal hormone therapy. They could have health risks for certain people with risk factors such as high blood pressure or a history of certain cancers. Talk to your doctor about whether these are right for you.

plain_text:
Pain during sex may be treated with over-the-counter
vaginal lubricants and moisturizers, or your doctor may
prescribe medication.
semantic_text: Pain during sex may be treated with over-the-counter vaginal lubricants and moisturizers, or your doctor may prescribe medication.

plain_text:
Complementary health practices such as natural products or
mind and body practices can help manage your menopausal
symptoms. However, talk to your doctor before using natural
products (such as black cohosh or soy isoflavones) as they
may cause other side effects, including liver damage.

plain_text:
MyMenoplan.org is a website that was developed with
support from NIH. MyMenoplan.org has a tool to find
treatment options based on your specific symptoms.

plain_text:
Some tips from the National Institute on Aging for better sleep and managing hot flashes
z.z.Carry a portable fan
z.z.Avoid alcohol, spicy foods, and caffeine (especially close to bedtime)
z.z.Avoid smoking
z.z.Maintain a healthy weight and exercise regularly, but avoid strenuous activity close to bedtime
z.z.Dress in layers that can be easily removed
z.z.Keep your bedroom a cooler temperature
z.z.Drink small amounts of cold water before bed
z.z.Adjust the number of layers of your bedding
z.z.Use mindfulness exercises such as meditation, yoga, or tai chi
z.z.Follow a regular sleep schedule and avoid naps in the late afternoon or evening
z.z.Take prescription or over-the-counter sleep medications such as melatonin
